templates.title: MCP Router
templates.description: MCP gateway: install MCP servers from registries or npm and serve them all over streamable HTTP, one endpoint each plus a merged one.
templates.note: Open the web UI on port 3000 and sign in with the token you set. Leave the token empty to have one generated and printed once to the container log.

env.name: MCP_ROUTER_TOKEN
env.label: Access token
env.description: Bearer token for the web UI, the API and every MCP endpoint. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

env.name: MCP_ROUTER_PORT
env.label: Host port
env.description: Port the web UI and the MCP endpoints are published on.

env.name: MCP_ROUTER_DATA
env.label: Data folder
env.description: Host folder for config, installed server packages and caches. It must be writable by uid 1000, which the container runs as.

env.name: SECURE_LOCAL_NET
env.label: Turn auth off
env.description: Only on a network you trust: no token is asked for anywhere.
